title: East Bay Housing, REALTOR, Political Finance, and TOD Records
description: Evidence-first public-record review of specified nonprofit, real-estate association, campaign-finance, lobbying, philanthropic, government, and transit-oriented-development leads. This is a research scope, not an allegation.

hypotheses.statement: The 2025 NAR REALTOR Political Coordinators roster lists Tia Hunnicutt as Federal Political Coordinator for Rep. Lateefah Simon.
Lateefah for Congress is the FEC-registered committee identified by C00834291.
BART recorded an individual vote by Lateefah Simon on item 22-461 on December 1, 2022, and its direction can be established from an official record.
alternative_explanations: The item likely passed by voice/consensus vote rather than an individually-recorded roll call, which is common for BART board items not specifically flagged for roll call.
missing_records: Archived BART board meeting video/audio (bart.gov/boardtv) for the 2022-12-01 meeting, not yet reviewed -- the only remaining avenue to learn Simon's individual presence, vote, or recusal on this item

hypotheses.statement: San Francisco Foundation awarded exactly $660,000 to Insight Housing / BFHP under an identifiable grant award.
The named institutional/financial/access relationships constitute improper influence, prohibited coordination, a conflict, or quid pro quo.
